player_prompt.intro:
Kcemm iseqdac {player_id} deg urar n HighSociety (tamuɣli n 2 n yiseqdac).
Asrag:     Kcemm mraw n tkeṛṛisit tettwazen walu ar tayeḍ.
Tazna:    Yal tazna, xtar-d s-ɣur-k  takarḍa n flus 1-11, d-ssufeɣ.
            • Tazna tameqqrant tewwi takarḍa n tkeṛṛisit, d-tettwakkes takarḍa n flus.
            • Tazna tameẓẓyant tettwaḥrez takarḍa n flus.
            • Tie -> tazna tettwakkes, d-tettwazen takarḍa n tkeṛṛisit tayed.
Tiswit:    Seld n mraw n tzniwin, rnu **flus iɣallen + tifranin n tkeṛṛisit**.
            *Taqacuct tameqqrant* tewwi (tie -> tifranin n tkeṛṛisit).

**Tasleḍt n tɣawsa**  →  xtar takarḍa tameẓẓyant am '[7]' neɣ '[11]'.
